Name: Personal Effects
Author: Mizzion
Description:
[center][img]http://bwdy.wtf/content/sdv/personaleffects/desc-header.png[/img][size=1]
[/size][/center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][b][code][/code][/b][/size][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b]
Personal Effects [/b][/size][size=3]could be considered a mod to improve the immersion of the game. It probably won't be. But it could. With this mod installed, some of your friendly village cohabitants will be a bit less careful with their, well, [i]personal effects[/i].  You might just occasionally catch a glimpse of an article of clothing left strewn out on the bedroom floor.
[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
[line]
[font=Tahoma][size=5][b]FEATURES[/b][/size][/font]

[/size][/font][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]Personal Effects [/b]will spawn rarely for each supported NPC.  These objects are cleared at the end of the day- they don't accumulate.
[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]The in-depth configuration file allows  for renaming NPCs, gender-bending, and even cross-dressing support.[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Multiple items per NPC means there are plenty of items to find.[/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Items might be found in the NPC's room (or home), around the bathhouse, or just occasionally, somewhere unexpected.
[/size][/font][/font]
[/list]
[line][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
[/size][/font][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Tahoma][size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size][/font][/size][/font][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]REQUIRES SMAPI.[/b][/size][/font][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]REQUIRES BWDYWORKS.[/b][/size][/font][/font]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Decompress and drag the contained mod folder into your /[i]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/i] folder. That's it!
[/font][/size][/list]
[line]
